messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete playable Darkest Dungeon-inspired game with three branching labyrinth paths per area, distinct enemies on each path, and paths converging at an area boss.

## Requirements
- User requested the specified art style and branching-path/boss structure.
- Build the game without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Retain the existing Ashen Path canvas auto-battler and extend it with three areas, each offering three themed lanes with two enemies and a shared boss.
- Increase starting vitality and attack, and provide three tonics to support the longer encounters.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added lane-map styling and data for three areas, each with three lanes, distinct enemies, and an area boss.
- Reworked expedition start to open the area route-selection map.
- Added lane selection, encounter setup, and route sidebar rendering.

### Active
- Integrate the new encounter flow with combat victory/reward/advance logic; existing `victory()` and `advance()` still use the old three-stage flow.
- Test full gameplay, verify browser behavior, and fix any issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Update `victory()` so clearing a lane enemy advances to its second enemy, then the area boss; defeating the boss should award a reward or finish the run after area three.
2. Update reward and area-transition behavior to preserve the selected route/progression and show the next area map.
3. Test the game in a browser and fix runtime or UI issues.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Existing single-file game; all changes so far are here.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Existing old flow functions remain in the file, including `showStage()`, `victory()`, `showReward()`, `advance()`, and `showEnding()`.
- No build or browser tests have been run.

- Build on the existing game without asking clarifying questions.

- Extend the existing single-file Ashen Path canvas auto-battler with three areas, each offering three themed lanes, two distinct enemies per lane, and a shared boss.
- Increase starting vitality and attack, and provide three starting tonics.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added three-area lane and enemy data, route-selection map, lane selection, encounter setup, and route sidebar rendering.
- Updated victory/reward/advance flow: each lane has two encounters followed by its area boss; boss victories grant rewards and progress to the next area or end the run.

### Active
- Test the full gameplay flow and browser behavior; fix any runtime or UI issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

1. Run the game through all three areas and verify route selection, combat progression, rewards, area transitions, and ending.
2. Check for JavaScript/runtime errors and UI issues, including the responsive layout.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Legacy `showStage()` remains in the file but is no longer used by the revised progression flow.
- No build or browser tests have been run.
